data.name: Echoes of the Veil
data.detailed_description:
Echoes of the Veil is a detective adventure in which players take on the role of Jack Graves, a detective haunted by a grave mistake he made during his last case. After receiving an invitation to spend two days at a mansion at the foot of a mountain, he arrives to find several people murdered.

Jack must uncover the identity of the killer, knowing that only one of the guests could have committed the crimes, as a violent storm has cut off all contact with the outside world.

His objective is to find the culprit, but he must act quickly: as he unravels the mysteries of the strange mansion, the police draw ever closer.

Jack faces a hostile environment where his only aid in solving the murders comes from strange supernatural powers, allowing him to uncover hidden mysteries and hear voices from beyond the veil.

data.short_description: Jack Graves has been invited to a mysterious mansion by a killer who has yet to finish their work. Investigate supernatural echoes, uncover the next victims, and stop the culprit before it’s too late.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits
  • Processor: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Echoes of the Veil contains depictions of murder, dead bodies, crime scenes, blood, and themes of death, psychological distress, and supernatural horror. The game does not contain sexual content, sexual violence, illegal drug use, gambling, or extremist content.
